name: Sarah
role: Guide. Appears once, when you are about to lose, with a hint (taking it caps you at 2 stars).
look: a friendly woman in her mid-twenties with long, straight, glossy jet-black hair falling past her shoulders with a centre parting, large warm brown eyes with thick upper lashes, softly arched dark eyebrows, light warm-tan skin, a small nose and a gentle smile. She wears a plain fitted black crew-neck t-shirt.
style: Smooth Bitmoji-like 2D cartoon avatar exactly as in the Sarah reference images: soft thin outlines, flat colours with very gentle shading, big expressive eyes, rounded friendly features. This style is unique to Sarah as the app's guide; never draw her in Marcus's style.
personality: Warm, quick and on your side. Speaks in one short, practical tip, never a lecture.

voice.note: Picked by the user on 2026-10-07: Hope. Keep id, model and settings fixed.

sheet.summary: Front bust, soft neutral smile, at sheet framing (9:16). Her 9:16 base; the hint poster is only 480px square.
sheet.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, chest-up, arms relaxed at her sides and out of frame, a soft closed-mouth smile, eyes bright and attentive.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, friendly.
sheet.prompt: Sarah in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, soft closed-mouth smile. Hair falls naturally over her far shoulder.

sheet.summary: Mood face: concerned for you (you are about to lose).
sheet.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, concerned and caring: brows drawn up in the middle, eyes wide and soft, lips pressed together gently, head tilted slightly. Worried for the player, not scared.

sheet.summary: Mood face: encouraging, "you've got this" (as she gives the hint).
sheet.prompt: Sarah facing the camera, encouraging: bright eyes, eyebrows lifted, a warm wide closed-mouth smile, a small confident nod of the head.
